meta_description:
235K likes, 4,517 comments - dolcegabbana on September 26, 2026: "@jlo arrived at the #DGSS27 Women’s Fashion Show “STRAVAGANZA SICILIANA”, in a #DolceGabbana look from the #DGFW26 Collection. She wore a black velvet tailored jacket and matching trousers, paired with a black waistcoat, a crisp white cotton shirt, black silk tie, black leather boots, and a Marlene Bag. The look was completed by #DGAltaGioielleria emerald and diamond earrings, a statement ring featuring an emerald, blue sapphires and diamonds, and a yellow and white gold stickpin brooch set with a green tourmaline and diamonds. 

#DGFattoAMano".
